snippet.title: Derby Championship Club video arcade game [UNIS; IAAPA 2018]
snippet.description:
Find out more about this product at: https://primetimeamusements.com/product/derby-champion-club/ - Ride your steed to victory in this realistic horse derby simulator, complete with life-sized horse controllers and game motion!

PrimeTime Amusements is a global operator, wholesale seller and event renter of brand new and refurbished video arcade machines, simulators, redemption games and more. Based out of Ft. Lauderdale, FL, we have been in business for over 25 years.
